characteristics.name: Abilities
characteristics.$text:
The bearer selects a second Path of Magic: it knows one spell from this Path, in addition to its other spells, selected from the Apprentice Spell or Adept Spells (#1-#4), and is otherwise not allowed to choose spells from this Path.
Ignore this Path for the purpose of Gates of the Netherworld.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Choose one of the following effects, for each target: [leftmargin=*]
  • The Rank-and-File part of the target Raises HP equal to its Rsr value.
  • One model in the target Recovers HP equal to its Rsr value. The following models cannot Recover more than 2 HP from this spell each Magic Phase:
  • Height 4--5 models with Solitary.
  • Characters and models with War Platform.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
At the end of each of your Player Turns, if there are no friendly models with Gates of the Netherworld on the Battlefield, each unit containing Ashes to Ashes loses X HP, where X is equal to half the Resurrected, value fractions are rounded up, (roll any dice when needed).
These hits can only be allocated onto models with Ashes to Ashes.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
During its Shooting Phase, the model part can make a Shooting Attack that targets all enemy units within 12" of the model (including those Engaged in Combat and outside Front Arc and/or Line of Sight).
This attack can be used even if the Altar is Engaged in Combat.
Each target suffers D6 hits with a Strength equal to the current Game Turn number, Armour Penetration 2, and Unmodifiable.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: Units entirely with Autonomous may perform March Moves as normal despite being Undead, even when outside the range of Commanding Presence of any friendly models.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The model can Raise Health Points above a unit’s starting size for the units stated within brackets (X). However, units cannot be increased beyond twice their starting size or beyond the unmodified maximum unit size (that is printed in their unit entry). A unit’s starting size is the size of the unit as written on the Army List or the size of the unit when it is Summoned.

characteristics.name: Banner Enchant
characteristics.$text:
Each turn, if the unit has been a target of at least one successfully cast friendly spell it gains Fight in Extra Rank, with Duration: One Turn.
In addition, during your Magic Phase, all spells targeting only the bearer’s unit gain a +1 modifier to their Casting Rolls.

characteristics.name: Abilities
characteristics.$text: The model’s Height is changed to 3, its base size is changed to 40×40mm, it gains Unholy Appetite, and +1 Res.

characteristics.name: Banner Enchant
characteristics.$text: Melee Attacks made by Skeleton model parts without Mount, in the bearer’s unit gain +1 to-hit.

characteristics.name: Abilities
characteristics.$text:
The bearer cannot know the Hereditary Spell, or have it as a Bound Spell, in any way.
Each time the bearer successfully casts a Learned Spell, you may discard one Magic Dice to successfully cast Arise!, targeting only the bearer’s unit.

characteristics.name: Attack Attribute
characteristics.$text: The Strength, Armour Penetration, and additional Attack Attributes are defined in brackets (X).

characteristics.name: Attack Attributes
characteristics.$text: March and Shoot, Magical Attacks, Hits Automatically, Psychic Attacks, Unmodifiable, *The number of shots is equal to the model’s current number of HP.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
When the model part allocates Attacks, it may choose to exchange all of its Standard Melee Attacks for a Grind Attack (HP*, Str 9, AP 10, Magical Attacks, Psychic Attacks, Unmodifiable)
*The number of hits is equal to the model’s current number of HP
*See Shrieking Horror unit entry

characteristics.name: Abilities
characteristics.$text: The Defensive Skill and Offensive Skill of Rank-and-File models in the bearer’s unit are set to 6.

characteristics.name: Abilities
characteristics.$text: The bearer gains Hatred, and its Vampiric rolls gain Maximised.

characteristics.name: Artefact
characteristics.$text:
During Pre-game Selections, choose a single model unit on the opponent’s Army List (remember: all Characters are single model units).
The wearer gains Hatred (chosen model) and Zeal (chosen model).

characteristics.name: Abilities
characteristics.$text: The bearer’s Melee Attacks ignore Parry, and must re-roll to-hit and to-wound rolls of ‘1’.

characteristics.name: Artefact
characteristics.$text: The bearer’s model gains Immune (Lethal Strike). When the model suffers a wound from an attack with Multiple Wounds (X), reduce the number of wounds suffered by 1, to a minimum of 1.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The Dark Coach’s base size is changed to 50×150mm, and gains one additional Phantom Host.

characteristics.name: Abilities
characteristics.$text: The model gains +2" Cha, +2" Mob, Fly and Swiftstride.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Uncommon. Must include at least 1.
  • If the model has chosen Evocation as its Path of Magic : whenever the model successfully casts the Hereditary Spell, all targets of the spell are considered to have +1 Rsr.
  • If the model has chosen a different path than Evocation as its Path of Magic : the model knows the Apprentice Spell (#1) in Evocation in addition to its other spells.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The model gains Aegis (3+, against non-Magical Attacks) and Aegis (5+).

characteristics.name: Abilities
characteristics.$text: The bearer and all Rank-and-File models in the bearer’s unit gain Poison Attacks.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The Monstrous Revenant gains Stomp Attack (D3) and its base size is changed to 60×100mm.

characteristics.name: Artefact
characteristics.$text: The wearer and all Rank-and-File models with Height 1--2 in its unit gain Parry.

characteristics.name: Abilities
characteristics.$text: The bearer’s Armour is set to 1, it gains Elven Finesse and loses Metal Armour. Additionally, if the model is of Height 1--2, it gains Distracting (1).

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The model can cast Pentagram of Pain (Occultism) as a Bound Spell (5+).

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
If Height 1--4, the model gains Regeneration (5+).
When the model casts Arise!, it may choose to set the spell’s Range to 6" and give it the Type: Aura (this choice is declared when selecting targets).
In addition, the model has access to Cosmology in addition to its normal Paths.

characteristics.name: Abilities
characteristics.$text:
The bearer gains Afflict (−1 Att, −1 Off).
Only Character models are affected by this instance of Afflict.

characteristics.name: Abilities
characteristics.$text: The bearer gains Multiple Wounds (2, towards Height 4--5).

characteristics.name: Abilities
characteristics.$text: The bearer’s Path access is replaced with Shamanism and Witchcraft.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: All friendly units within 6" of one or more models with Necromantic Aura reduce the number of HP losses caused by Ashes to Ashes and Unstable by 1.

characteristics.name: Artefact
characteristics.$text: The wielder gains Channel (1), and can cast Arise! (Hereditary Spell) as a Bound Spell (5+), with the following changes : Range is set to 6", and it gains the Type: Aura.

characteristics.name: Artefact
characteristics.$text: Attacks against the bearer suffer −1 to-wound.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Friendly Rank-and-File models in units within 6" benefit from Regeneration (6+). In addition:

  • Ghasts benefit from Regeneration (4+).
  • Models from Core also benefit from First Strike (Regeneration (+1, max. 5+)).
*See Cadaver Wagon unit entry.

characteristics.name: Weapon Enchant
characteristics.$text: Strength set to 10, Armour Penetration set to 10, Divine Attacks and Psychic Attacks.

characteristics.name: Abilities
characteristics.$text: The bearer gains +1 Arm and the model part with Vampire gains Fury.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Soul Tether: The model selects of the following Spells.
Arise! always has the following changes: Range is set to 6", and it gains Aura.

characteristics.name: Abilities
characteristics.$text: All units within 12" of the bearer’s model benefit from Hard Target (1).

characteristics.name: Abilities
characteristics.$text: The bearer’s Armour is set to 0, its HP are set to 4, it gains First Strike (Hatred) and loses Metal Armour. Additionally, if it is without Mount, it gains Regeneration (4+).

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
The model can cast The Dead Arise as a Bound Spell (5+).The Dead Arise: Range: 12", Type : Ground, Duration : Instant.
Summon a Skeletons or Zombies unit. Declare which when selecting the target. The unit has a number of Health Points corresponding to its Rsr. All upgrades except Command Group Options are allowed. Note: all models must be placed within the spell’s Range, with at least one model touching the target point.

characteristics.name: Weapon Enchant
characteristics.$text:
+1 Str, +1 AP, Unholy Appetite and Vampiric (3+).
If the wielder’s model has Height 4 or 5 , the wielder gains Vampiric (5+) instead of Vampiric (3+).

characteristics.name: Abilities
characteristics.$text: During Combat Choices, select a single friendly unit Engaged in the same Combat as the bearer (this can be its own unit): this unit gains Stubborn. Duration: End of Turn.

characteristics.name: Attack Attribute
characteristics.$text: After a Round of Combat in which at least one attack with Unholy Appetite caused any HP loss, all attacks from the same unit with Unholy Appetite gain Hatred until the end of the next Player Turn.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: Friendly units within 6" of the model benefit from Autonomous.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: Friendly units within 6" of one or more models with Unnatural Activity benefit from +2 Off and +2 Agi.

characteristics.name: Attack Attribute
characteristics.$text:
At the end of each Melee Phase, check and resolve the following effects for all models with Vampiric:
  • Character (or Attachable Model): if at least one attack with Vampiric made by the Character (or Attachable Model) caused any HP loss against enemy units, the model with Vampiric can make a single Vampiric roll.
If successful, the model Recovers a single HP.
  • Rank-and-File model: if at least one attack with Vampiric made by a Rank-and-File model in the unit caused any HP loss against enemy units, the unit can make a single Vampiric roll.
If successful, the units Rank-and-File Health Pool Raises a single HP. A Vampiric roll is successful if the D6 scores X+, where X is the number stated within brackets. If a unit or Character has multiple model parts with this Attack Attribute that each caused a HP loss, use the best value.

characteristics.name: Abilities
characteristics.$text: The bearer gains Awaken (Bat Swarms, Dire Wolves, Great Bats, Zombies), Disciplined, Unholy Conduit, and Vampiric (4+).

characteristics.$text: March and Shoot, Unmodifiable, Magical Attacks, Hits Automatically
